heros.infro: He came to power in 1440 following the death of his uncle.  He crafted the Triple Alliance between the Aztects, the Texcoco, and the Tlacopan.  With Nezahualcoyotl of Texcoco, Montezuma oversaw the construction of the fresh water aqueducts that supplied Tenochtitlan.  He also saw expansion of the Empire, leading a campaign against the Mixtecs, which greatly expanded his territory.  It is said that his name was actually Ilhuicamina, and it was changed posthumously to link him with the later Montezuma.
heros.name: Montezuma I
